meals.title: Braai Pork Chops with Foil-Roasted Butternut and Cucumber Yoghurt Salad
meals.why: Pork braai chops at R69.99 and butternut at R14.99/kg make a cheap, filling braai meal, and the yoghurt doubles as salad dressing.
method: Cube the butternut, toss with oil, salt and pepper, wrap in foil parcels and place on the coals for 30-35 minutes, turning once.
Rub the chops with oil and braai spice, then leave them for 10 minutes.
Braai the chops over medium coals for about 6-8 minutes per side until cooked through.
Dice the cucumber and stir into the yoghurt with crushed garlic, lemon juice, mint and salt.
Rest the chops for 5 minutes and serve with the butternut and cucumber salad.

meals.title: Creamy Butternut and Tomato Curry with Parboiled Rice
meals.why: Butternut at R14.99/kg is the star of this vegetarian curry, and rice and canned tomatoes stretch it to feed the whole household cheaply.
method: Fry a chopped onion, garlic and ginger in oil until soft, then stir in the curry powder and tomato paste for 1 minute.
Add the cubed butternut, chopped tomatoes and half a can of water, then season with salt.
Simmer covered for 20-25 minutes until the butternut is tender. Add chickpeas for the last 5 minutes if using.
Cook the rice according to the packet while the curry simmers.
Take the curry off the heat, stir in a few spoonfuls of yoghurt and serve over the rice.

meals.title: Quick Beef Mince Macaroni
meals.why: Lean mince, macaroni at R14 and canned tomatoes make a one-pot dinner that is on the table in about 25 minutes.
method: Boil the macaroni in salted water for about 10 minutes, then drain.
Meanwhile, brown the mince with chopped onion and garlic in a large pan, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in the tomato paste, chopped tomatoes, mixed herbs, salt and pepper, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Toss the drained macaroni through the sauce and top with cheese if you like.

meals.title: Slow-Cooked Beef Potjiekos with Carrots and Potatoes
meals.why: PnP Beef Potjiekos at R99.99 plus cheap carrots and potatoes makes a one-pot Sunday-style meal that feeds a crowd and gets better as it cooks.
also_need: splash of red wine or water
method: Brown the potjiekos in batches in a heavy pot or Dutch oven with a little oil, then set it aside.
Fry sliced onions and garlic in the same pot, then stir in the tomato paste.
Return the meat with the stock cube dissolved in 1 cup of hot water, the bay leaves and the wine if using. Cover and simmer on low (or at 160°C in the oven) for 1.5-2 hours.
Add the chunked carrots and halved potatoes and cook for another 45-60 minutes, until the meat is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Cook the rice and serve it alongside the potjie.

meals.title: Oven-Baked Chicken Traybake with Butternut and Carrots
meals.why: SPAR's 4kg frozen chicken portions (R154.99) are cheap per meal, and cooking them with butternut and carrots on one tray means almost no washing up.

uses.item: SPAR Frozen Chicken Mixed Portions with a Brine Based Mixture (4kg)

also_need: salt (go easy, the chicken is brined)
method: Thaw the chicken portions you need overnight in the fridge, then pat them dry and heat the oven to 200°C.
Toss the chicken with oil, paprika, garlic powder, herbs and pepper.
Spread chunked butternut and carrots on a large tray, drizzle with oil and nestle the chicken on top.
Roast for 45-55 minutes, turning the veg once, until the chicken is golden and cooked through.
Freeze the remaining portions for future meals.

meals.title: Quick Shakshuka with Toasted Panini
meals.why: A dozen-plus eggs at R64.99 for 18 and canned tomatoes make a cheap, protein-rich dinner in about 25 minutes, with panini for scooping.
method: Soften a sliced onion and garlic in oil in a wide pan, then stir in the cumin, paprika and tomato paste.
Add the chopped tomatoes and simmer for 8-10 minutes until thick, seasoning to taste.
Make wells in the sauce, crack in 6-8 eggs, cover and cook for 5-7 minutes until the whites are set.
Toast the panini and slice the avocado.
Serve the shakshuka straight from the pan with the panini and avocado.
